title: Disable CUPS on Linux
snippet: To disable CUPS - including preventing it from restarting after a reboot - please follow these steps: Stop the CUPS Service: sudo systemctl stop cups.

title: How to restart the CUPS daemon ?
snippet: To start CUPS (as root): systemctl start cups (and for restart, the restart command) But better first check it's status: systemctl status cups.
